title: Selenium Exercises
description: Practise the ideas from this Selenium course. Each answer has an explanation to help you learn.

exercises.question: What does WebDriver control?
exercises.explanation: Selenium controls a browser through WebDriver. A data URL can hold a tiny HTML page for a local practice test. The check passes when the heading says Library.

exercises.question: Which locator finds this button?
exercises.explanation: An ID should identify one page element. Selenium can use it to find a control. The check reads the Save button.

exercises.question: Which call returns several matches?
exercises.explanation: find_elements returns a list of all matches. It is different from find_element, which returns one match. The list has two matching elements.

exercises.question: Where is the typed text stored?
exercises.explanation: send_keys types into an element. Read the value property to see what the field now contains. The input value becomes Moon.

exercises.question: What confirms the action?
exercises.explanation: A click asks the browser to activate a control. Check the resulting page state. After the click, the button reads Done.

exercises.question: What does p.notice select?
exercises.explanation: A CSS selector describes elements by tags, classes or attributes. Keep it short and tied to a clear target. The selector chooses a paragraph with class notice.

exercises.question: Which method reads checkbox state?
exercises.explanation: A checkbox has a selected state that can be inspected. Clicking toggles that state. The checkbox is selected after the click.

exercises.question: What value selects Large?
exercises.explanation: Selenium's Select helper handles a native select element. Choose an option by its stored value. The selected option is Large.

exercises.question: What ends the wait successfully?
exercises.explanation: An explicit wait checks for a condition until a time limit. It is more useful than always sleeping a fixed length. The wait returns when the Ready element is visible, or fails after its limit.

exercises.question: Which key is used to move forward?
exercises.explanation: Keyboard actions help check access beyond mouse clicks. Tab normally moves focus to the next control. Focus moves to the second input.

exercises.question: What should you locate after replacement?
exercises.explanation: A page can replace a DOM element. A saved old element reference may then be stale, so locate the current element again. The fresh locator finds the replacement paragraph.

exercises.question: What closes the browser in these examples?
exercises.explanation: A screenshot helps show what the browser displayed. Always release browser resources when a test ends. A screenshot is saved locally after the visibility check. The surrounding finally block closes the browser.
